name: Aladdin
description: Coming on the heels of the direct-to-video sequel The Return of Jafar, the series picked up where that installment left off, with Aladdin now living in the palace, engaged to beautiful and spunky Princess Jasmine. "Al" and Jasmine went together into peril among sorcerers, monsters, thieves, and more. Monkey sidekick Abu, the animated Magic Carpet, and the fast-talking, shape-shifting Genie came along to help, as did sassy, complaining parrot Iago, formerly Jafar’s pet but now an antihero.

videos.title: Getting The Bugs Out
videos.overview: It is discovered that mechanical bugs have infested every mechanical device in Agrabah. The Sultan requests that Aladdin investigate them. Aladdin finds that an evil genius, named Mechanickles, is behind the damage.

videos.title: Mudder's Day
videos.overview: Aladdin and co. are captured by mud creatures called the AlMuddi, and they need water in order to beat them, but it's hard to find that in a desert so they use the next best possible way of beating them. The sun!

videos.title: Fowl Weather
videos.overview: Agrabah is a very hot place, so to cool it down Aladdin wants to take a rain cloud, but there's only one problem. The rain clouds have a keeper. A bird named Thundra, so Iago distracts Thundra with his parrot like charm while Aladdin takes the rain cloud. When Thundra finds out that one of her rain clouds are missing Iago finds out that business and pleasure don't mix.

videos.title: The Prophet Motive
videos.overview: A prophecy of doom for Aladdin spells disaster for the evil monster of Fashoom.

videos.title: Much Abu About Something
videos.overview: An ancient civilization is giving premonitions to Abu. Aladdin thinks the premonitions are for himself. Abu shows that size doesn't matter by saving the ancient civilization from a dinosaur.

videos.title: My Fair Aladdin
videos.overview: Aladdin feels left out when the Sultan and Jasmine have their royal parties, so Iago teaches Aladdin some manners. Aladdin impresses everyone at the next royal party except for Jasmine who wants him to be himself. Aladdin gets a little conceited, and overcomes this when he has to stop one of Mechanickles' evil schemes.

videos.title: To Cure a Thief
videos.overview: Abu constantly steals whatever he likes and causes the Aladdin trouble as a new palace resident. Aladdin tries to keep Abu on a leash to keep him from mischief, but Abu hates it and runs away.

videos.title: Never Say Nefir
videos.overview: The city of Gezistan crashes everyday and it's up to Aladdin and friends to stop whatever is causing it. They find that a group of imps are doing the damage, then turning around and accepting payment by the sultan of Gezistan to fix the damage.

videos.title: Raiders Of The Lost Shark
videos.overview: A land swimming shark rampages through Agrabah. Aladdin and company climb aboard Captain Murk's flying ship to hunt it down.

videos.title: Air Feathered Friends
videos.overview: Abu often steals dates out of trees so Rasoul threatens to throw Abu in jail if he steals one more. Later, someone sets Abu up for stealing more dates and Aladdin must prove him innocent by finding Abis Mal.

videos.title: Bad Mood Rising
videos.overview: A little king rules over a precious area, but if the people don't keep him happy his bad moods will cause bad weather. It's up to Aladdin and company to keep him happy until the prince can learn to fend for himself.

videos.title: Do the Rat Thing
videos.overview: Aladdin doubts that Jasmine could survive as a street rat. Jasmine gets angry at this, so she spends an entire day at the marketplace. She steals a mirror that casts a magic spell on her and becomes a real rat while Iago becomes a frilled lizard.

videos.title: The Vapor Chase
videos.overview: Abis Mal is able to steal from Agrabah blind. He does this by burning this magical powder that creates smoke demons when burned.

videos.title: Garden of Evil
videos.overview: 20 years ago the young Sultan had to pass through an evil plant-man's garden. The Sultan promised to give the plant-man his most precious treasure in return for safe passage. Now the evil plant-man has come back for the Sultan's most precious treasure: Jasmine!

videos.title: Some Enchanted Genie
videos.overview: Abis Mal steals Genie's lamp. While Genie's on his quest to find his home he meets a female Genie along the way. Her name is Eden, and she is the master of a poor boy. The 3 of them all help Genie find his lamp, and when they catch up with Abis Mal he decides to dump Genie, and be Eden's new master.

videos.title: Web of Fear
videos.overview: A colony of sinister spider like creatures called the Unkhbut have kidnapped Jasmine.

videos.title: Plunder the Sea
videos.overview: Mechanickles has created a mechanical sea monster that's tearing up the seas of the seven desserts. Now its up to Aladdin and a rude captain named Captain Al Bahtross.

videos.title: Strike Up the Sand
videos.overview: Aladdin saves a fellow street rat named Sadira from Rasoul. After this act she instantly falls in love with Aladdin, but he already has a girlfriend. This ticks her off and she decides to become a sand witch. She uses her powers to make Aladdin fall in love with her, but the power of true love is stronger than her magic.

videos.title: Sneeze the Day
videos.overview: Genie catches a magical cold that effects his magic that prevents him from controlling his magic. Iago and Aladdin find a magic orb to cure him.

videos.title: I Never Mechanism I Didn't Like
videos.overview: Mechanickles is tired of Aladdin foiling his plans so he gets an evil hypnotic robot to bring them around to his way of thinking.

videos.title: Forget Me Lots
videos.overview: Abis Mal gets the rose of forgetfulness. His original plan was to use it on the Sultan to take over his throne, but Jasmine gets a hold of it instead. Now Abis Mal uses Jasmine as an insurance policy to taking over Agrabah.

videos.title: Scare Necessities
videos.overview: Jasmine receives a cute little animal for a present. The problem is that this little animal was the power to make your fears come true which makes him a target for evil.

videos.title: SandSwitch
videos.overview: Sadira uses a magic spell to trade lives with Jasmine, so Aladdin can love her. Now Sadira is a princess and Jasmine is a street rat. The spell effects everyone except for the animals ( Abu, Iago, and Rajah), so they save the day.

videos.title: Lost and Founded
videos.overview: Abis Mal uses a time machine to go back in time to avoid Jasmine's father to become the Sultan so he can be the Sultan of Agrabah. If he succeeds not only will Abis Mal be the Sultan, but Jasmine's will no longer exist.

videos.title: Moonlight Madness
videos.overview: Aladdin and Jasmine have a very romantic date and before he can finish it the others want him to help them find a treasure.

videos.title: The Flawed Couple
videos.overview: Abis Mal and Mechanickles team up to get their revenge on Aladdin. They do it by these magical jewels. Each jewel possesses a certain bad feeling or emotion. The jewels effect everyone except for Aladdin who decides to reverse the curse and use the jewels on Mechanickles and Abis Mal.

videos.title: Rain of Terror
videos.overview: Thundra is tired of doing her job of controlling the weather, so Iago says that he'll take over her job while she takes a vacation. All goes well until Iago makes a bad deal with Thundra's rival Malcho. Iago gives him Thundra's weather medallion, and it's up to him to him to beat Malcho and get the medallion back for Thundra.

videos.title: Dune Quixote
videos.overview: Sadira puts a spell on Aladdin so he will love her over Jasmine, but the spell goes wrong and now Aladdin thinks he's Don Quixote. The only way to cure this spell is a kiss from Sadira, but Jasmine won't allow it.

videos.title: That Stinking Feeling
videos.overview: Prince Uncouthma of Odifferous comes for Jasmine, and Aladdin thinks he has no reason to be jealous, but when Jasmine starts flirting with him to make Aladdin jealous he starts to realize what he's got.

videos.title: The Day The Bird Stood Still
videos.overview: Abis Mal puts a curse on the Sultan's bathing oils to turn him to stone, but Iago uses it instead and has before sundown to get the cure. He does everything that he can to get it.

videos.title: Of Ice and Men
videos.overview: After Aladdin and company take a trip to the frozen north they meet an ice efreet named Frajhid. He gives Agrabah something they've never had: snow, but soon gets caught up wanting the people of Agrabah to be living in an icy wonderland.

videos.title: Opposites Detract
videos.overview: Aladdin and friends encounter a dragon while on a trading mission.

videos.title: Caught by the Tale
videos.overview: Two kids love the stories of the heroic adventures of Aladdin, so Genie, Iago, and Abu tell them some. All goes well until Abis Mal starts telling them more and tricks the kids into helping him find a treasure.

videos.title: Elemental, My Dear Jasmine
videos.overview: An evil sea mermaid named Saleen has the elemental power of water. She usually uses this ability to drown sailors, but this time she's caught Jasmine. When she finds out that Jasmine has a boyfriend she decides to hook, line, and sink him.

videos.title: Beast or Famine
videos.overview: Genie becomes the target of a shaman who wants his magical powers and will go to great lengths to get them.

videos.title: Smolder and Wiser
videos.overview: Abis Mal threatens Agrabah with a fire elemental who causes destruction. The elemental, Magma, is a relentless beast who has no limits. Even if Genie and Aladdin can manage a way to defeat him, they'll still have to beat Abis Mal to save Agrabah.

videos.title: The Game
videos.overview: Genie has never won a game against carpet, but when he meets two game-loving wizards, how far will he go to win?

videos.title: Poor Iago
videos.overview: Iago can't stand being greedy so he steals valuables to give away.

videos.title: The Spice Is Right
videos.overview: Aladdin finds a chest filled with spice and a necklace. When he gives them to Jasmine he releases Ayam Aghoul, the duke of the dead who wants to marry Jasmine.

videos.title: The Animal Kingdom
videos.overview: Aladdin and company find themselves in a village with talking animals. These animals are prejudiced against humans and don't trust them, but when Aladdin saves the day they learn that you need to judge each creature by their actions.

videos.title: Power to the Parrot
videos.overview: Iago thinks that Genie's magical job is easy, so Genie gives Iago his powers for a day. Iago has fun with it at first, but then he realizes what a tough job it is to be a genie.

videos.title: The Sands of Fate
videos.overview: Aladdin and company are caught between two armies of horsemen fighting each other. This wouldn't be such a tough battle if there weren't only one problem. The battle keeps repeating itself everyday. As each day goes on each member of Aladdin's team either gets captured or turned into a horseman. Now it's up to Iago to figure out how to save the day, and to stop whatever keeps making the battle repeat.

videos.title: Hero with a Thousand Feathers
videos.overview: Iago is destined to wake up an ancient evil, and when he does it tramples Agrabah. Iago gets frightened and blames Genie.

videos.title: The Citadel
videos.overview: Evil sorcerer Mozenrath is looking for someone who can take challenges. He learns about Aladdin, and when he does he kidnaps Genie to force Aladdin to rescue him and destroy a monster called Thirdak who's trying to eat Genie's magic.

videos.title: Snowman Is an Island
videos.overview: Aladdin and friends are forced to go through a castle when there's no other way around, and the resident decides he wants Genie to stay and be his court jester.

videos.title: The Secret of Dagger Rock
videos.overview: On a lovely day Aladdin and Jasmine are about to go on a date, but it is quickly ruined by Mozenrath. He kidnaps Aladdin for Genie, and now Jasmine has to disguise herself as a guard to rescue him.

videos.title: In the Heat of the Fright
videos.overview: Aladdin and friends meet Mirage, the evil catwoman with incredible powers.

videos.title: Witch Way Did She Go?
videos.overview: The ancient witches of the sand have returned to rule Agrabah and Sadira must choose between power and real friendship.

videos.title: The Seven Faces of Genie
videos.overview: Genie experiments by giving himself seven split personalities, but something goes wrong and those personalities split out of him and rampage all over Ghezistan.

videos.title: The Wind Jackal of Mozenrath
videos.overview: Aladdin, Jasmine, and Abu go out on a secret mission to stop Mozenrath's new evil magical creature: a wind jackal. Convinced that they've gone on a treasure hunt without him, Iago gets Genie and carpet to go after them. What they don't know is that Mozenrath's got magic detectors all over his kingdom.

videos.title: A Clockwork Hero
videos.overview: Mechanickles decides to be a father and builds himself a robotic son, but things go wrong when this robot son has a mind of his own.

videos.title: Mission: Imp Possible
videos.overview: Nefir and the imps are back, and they've got a new plan. To steal the golden silk of Panacea.

videos.title: Stinker Belle
videos.overview: Aladdin and Jasmine travel to Odiferous to attend Uncouthma's wedding, but someone is trying to ruin the happy couple's wedding day.

videos.title: Sea No Evil
videos.overview: A message meant for Aladdin gets sidetracked by Iago and Abu.

videos.title: Shadow of a Doubt
videos.overview: Mirage tries to eliminate Agrabah with a black spire that eliminates anything its shadow touches. Can Aladdin and friends stop her before Agrabah disappears at sundown?

videos.title: Smells Like Trouble
videos.overview: It's the return of the newlyweds Uncouthma and his wife. This time they have a son, and he thinks brawn is the only way to solve problems. But when a real problem comes up and lizards are affecting Odiferious' cheese Aladdin teaches him it's good to have brains and brawn.

videos.title: The Way We War
videos.overview: Nefir and his imps are making Agrabah and Odiferous go to war. The imps are supplying both cities with war supplies and making a nice profit it at the same time.

videos.title: Night of the Living Mud
videos.overview: Aladdin gets some well deserved relaxation time, but when Iago tracks Al Muddi mud into the palace, can he, Abu, and Genie handle it without Aladdin?

videos.title: Egg-stra Protection
videos.overview: A griffin is terrorizing Gezistan and its all Abis Mal's fault.

videos.title: A Sultan Worth His Salt
videos.overview: Jasmine is kidnapped by Queen Hipposedeth and her amazons. Everyone else gets defeated and so it is up to the Sultan to save the day and get his daughter back.

videos.title: Heads, You Lose
videos.overview: Aladdin and friends are tricked into finding an evil wizard's body. When they do the wizard attaches his head to his body then removes Aladdin's head from his own!

videos.title: The Love Bug
videos.overview: Mechanical termites are tearing down Thundra's rain forest. When Aladdin and company tell Thundra that they've found out that Mechanickles is doing this Thundra decides to take care of him herself.

videos.title: When Chaos Comes Calling
videos.overview: Aladdin gets overconfident and thinks he can overcome any challenge that evil presents him so Chaos, the ultimate evil, gives him a real challenge.

videos.title: Genie Hunt
videos.overview: Genie's old master allows a muktar to hunt Genie to get him back.

videos.title: Armored and Dangerous
videos.overview: A rampaging monster named Dominous Tusk becomes a threat to Agrabah while Aladdin and genie are gone. The Sultan decides to don a suit of armor from an ancient warrior. The Sultan successfully defeats Dominous and all of Agrabah wants him as their protector. However, the more the Sultan uses the armor the more possessed he becomes with the spirit of that ancient warrior.

videos.title: The Lost Ones
videos.overview: Children are disappearing all over Agrabah. Aladdin has to stop El Katib from taking them.

videos.title: Eye of the Beholder
videos.overview: Mirage argues that love is weak, while Fashir thinks that it is stronger than her evil. Mirage sells Jasmine a magic lotion that turns her into a snake. Aladdin loves her anyway, but can't touch her because he'll die, so he proves that love is stronger by turning into a snake with her.

videos.title: Shark Treatment
videos.overview: Saleen turns Aladdin into a shark, so she can have a new sea animal to play with.

videos.title: Black Sand
videos.overview: Each one of Aladdin's friends gets replaced by undead mamluks.

videos.title: Love at First Sprite
videos.overview: A group of sprites teach Aladdin how to fly and carpet feels left out. When the sprites want to play all the time they seem to good to be true and carpet teaches them a lesson they'll never forget.

videos.title: Vocal Hero
videos.overview: Butterfingers has some tricks up his sleeve and he's after the Sultan who's been turned into a miniature gold statue.

videos.title: The Lost City of the Sun
videos.overview: Mozenrath enslaves the sprites and forces them to find a lost city that contains an enormous amount of power. Some sprites escape and go to Aladdin for help.

videos.title: As the Netherworld Turns
videos.overview: Iago acts greedy again and this time it leads them to the Netherworld. Now they are trapped in the Netherworld with Ayam Aghoul. Can Iago and Abu escape and prevent Aladdin from falling into Ayam's trap?

videos.title: Seems Like Old Crimes (1)
videos.overview: When Aladdin finds out that 3 theives from the past have somehow turned into powerful magical creatures he tries to stop them. Before he can do so all of Aladdin's friends (except Abu) ask him who are these old thieves, so Aladdin tells him how he knows these theives.

videos.title: Seems Like Old Crimes (2)
videos.overview: After telling the story of how he met them, Aladdin and co. go find their headquarters to put a stop to them once and for all.

videos.title: From Hippsodeth, with Love
videos.overview: Queen Hippsodeth has fallen in love with the Sultan of Agrabah, but King Pecter has fallen in love with her. A deadly love triangle means trouble for the Sultan and Agrabah.

videos.title: Destiny on Fire
videos.overview: Aziz is back, and he's turned the Sultan, Jasmine, and the rest of Agrabah into slugs while Aladdin and the gang are on vacation. Rasoul is the only one from the palace who has managed to escape. Aladdin and Rasoul must find a way to work together to finally beat Aziz without fighting each other in the process.

videos.title: The Return of Malcho
videos.overview: The Sultan and everyone else are going on a little trip except for Aladdin and Iago. The Sultan tells Aladdin to take charge of the kingdom while he'a away. All goes well until Malcho comes back from the frozen north to get his revenge on Iago. Now Aladdin has to protect Iago and the kingdom against him.In the end Malcho decides to now take his revenge out on Aladdin instead.

videos.title: The Hunted
videos.overview: Mozenrath hires the Muktar to capture Genie. Muktar hunts down every one of Genie's friends and leaves Genie for Mozenrath, but struck by Genie's friendship he decides to help Genie defeat Mozenrath and free the others.

videos.title: Riders Redux
videos.overview: Marauders are blocking a trade route between Agrabah and other deserts. Aladdin investigates the situation only to find out that the leader is stopping time, stealing the deliveries, and capturing the tradesmen.

videos.title: The Book of Khartoum
videos.overview: Genie's got a date with his genie girlfriend Eden, but he gets a little sidetracked when Mozenrath kidnaps him for his power in order towake Khartoum. Eden gets angry and by the time she finds Genie Mozenrath decides that two genies are better than one.

videos.title: While the City Snoozes
videos.overview: Mirage has opened up a magical music box, and everyone in Agrabah has fallen asleep forever except Aladdin and Jasmine. Can they stay awake and shut down Mirage's music box before the whole world falls asleep?

videos.title: Two to Tangle
videos.overview: Mozenrath's magic glove is destroying his body and  he's  decided to switch bodies with Aladdin, but something goes wrong and they both wind up in Aladdin's body.

videos.title: The Ethereal
videos.overview: Jasmine has a dream about the destruction of Agrabah. She tells the others, and they think she's crazy until it comes true. An evil being called the ethereal comes to judge Agrabah and she's not happy by what she sees.

videos.title: The Shadow Knows
videos.overview: Ayam Aghoul escapes the Netherworld and uses his shadow to remove the shadows of Aladdin and his friends. They all have to get their shadows back or they'll join Ayam Aghoul in the Netherworld by sundown.

videos.title: The Great Rift
videos.overview: Aladdin discovers the Lost Jewels of Mizmeria. One of the jewels is taken by a bird who used to be a king. In the sun the jewel becomes Queen Deluca.

country: United States, Australia, Japan, Philippines, Canada, Brazil, Taiwan, South Korea
